# NYC Selected Gallery Guide, November 2026

November 2, 2026 12:56 pm

Shrine: Loren Erdrich, _Near Elsewhere_, 2026, water, acrylic, watercolor and dye on muslin, 52 x 56 in.

November settles in with a full roster and I’m up for it. In Tribeca, Klaus von Nichtssagend presents Tamara Gonzales, Bortolami has Rebecca Morris, who is looking kind of rosy in the preview image. Is she finally embracing a more traditional form of beauty? We’ll see. At CANADA, Xylor Jane is back with “Paintings for People.” Down on the Lower East Side, Shrine is showing Loren Erdrich while Post Times has a Fergus Feehily show, which seems like a perfect match. In Chelsea, Petzel presents Tschabalala Self, and Nicola Vassell Gallery has LIC pal Pam Glick, who says she never could have made this body of work if she hadn’t moved back to NYC. Julie Curtiss is having her first show at (gasp) Gagosian, and Eric Fischl is back with another solo at Skarstedt. Jason Stopa continues his exploration of brightly-colored architectural forms at Morgan Lehman, and Sherrie Levine is at Galerie Buchholz. If you find yourself in DUMBO, please stop by Springs Projects, 20 Jay Street, Suite 311B, to see “On Certain Grounds,” my show with Cate Holt. The opening is Thursday, November 5, 6-8 pm. I’d love to see you. – _Sharon Butler_
